source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transition metals as catalysts (PDF 21-22).

blocks.text: Transition elements do wajuhaat se mo'assar catalysts hain.

items: Yeh mustahkam oxidation states ke darmiyan aasani se badalte hain (maslan Fe2+ <=> Fe3+). Dhaat ka ion reactant ke saath aik na-mustahkam darmiyani compound banata hai; yeh jaldi product deta aur catalyst apne asal oxidation state par wapas aa jata hai, jis se kam activation energy ka raasta milta hai. Yeh aam taur par homogeneous catalysis mein hota hai; maslan acetylene se acrylic acid banane mein use hone wale nickel ke namak Ni(0) aur Ni(II) states ke zariye kaam karte hain.

In ke paas khaali d orbitals hain jo tawanai ke lihaz se qabil-e-rasai hain. Reactant molecules catalyst ki satah se jur kar aarzi activated complex banate hain jo unhein sahi rukh mein thaame rakhta aur activation energy kam karta hai. Phir products satah chhor dete (desorb) aur catalyst dobara tayyar hota hai. Yeh heterogeneous catalysis ki pehchan hai, jaise nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia banane ke Haber process mein thos loha.

blocks.prompt: Vanadium +2 se +5 tak oxidation states kaise dikha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: V [Ar] 3d3 4s2 hai. 3d aur 4s tawanai mein qareeb hone se yeh apne do 4s electrons (+2) aur phir aik, do ya teen 3d electrons (+3, +4, +5) kho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Complex ion banne mein ligand ka kya kirdar hai, aur kis qism ka bond banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ligand dhaat ke ion ko electrons ka lone pair deta hai, jis se coordinate (dative covalent) bond banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Transition metals bonding mein 4s aur 3d dono electrons kyun use karte hain, s-block anasir ke baraks?
blocks.explanation: In ke 3d aur 4s subshells tawanai mein bohat qareeb hain, is liye 3d electrons taqreeban 4s ki tarah aasani se nikalte hain; s-block anasir mein andaruni electrons kaheen kam tawanai par hain aur use nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: Fe3+ ki configuration likhein. Fe2+/Fe3+ ki tabdeeli catalysis mein kyun mufeed hai?
blocks.explanation: Fe3+ [Ar] 3d5 hai. Loha aasani se +2 aur +3 ke darmiyan badalta hai, is liye aik reactant se electrons le kar doosre ko de sakta aur phir apni asal halat par aa jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Transition metals ki kaun si khasiyatein unhein heterogeneous aur homogeneous catalysts banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Heterogeneous: khaali, qabil-e-rasai d orbitals jo reactants ko dhaat ki satah se aarzi jorne dete. Homogeneous: badalte oxidation states jo ion ko darmiyani compounds banane aur torne dete.

items: Homogeneous: badalte oxidation states (Fe2+ <=> Fe3+; Ni(0)/Ni(II)).
Heterogeneous: khaali d orbitals satah par reactants jorte (Haber process mein Fe).
